verdict: Clean, fully-real implementation. Uses the real bl-accordion-group (multiple open by default) wrapping three real bl-accordion items, each using only real API members: caption and icon="info" (both verified; icon="info" appears verbatim in the official bl-accordion story). Content is placed in each accordion's real default slot, so the native <details>/<summary> click-to-expand behavior works out of the box with group-faq semantics. No hallucinated attributes, slots, or events; no hand-rolled native controls where a real bl-* component exists. The only very minor nit is that the FAQ answers are static text without custom markup around them, which is fully acceptable.
